items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 12 May 2026 4:12am
items.description:
##Today##

A few outbreaks of rain to start but this will clear by mid-morning as sunny intervals develop. Then the risk of the odd shower thereafter, these becoming frequent overnight into Wednesday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W or NW 15-20, occasionally 25, increasing 20-32 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Isolated hill fog, mainly to start.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Tomorrow##

Sunshine and blustery showers, heavy at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

26


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

W or NW, soon veering NW 20-32, decreasing 15-25 overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers. Isolated hill fog in showers.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Risk heavy showers.


##Thursday, 14 May 2026##

Cloudy start with a few showery outbreaks of rain, the showers becoming isolated into the afternoon as sunny intervals develop.

22

NW

##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers. Occasional hill fog mainly at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.
